compatibility_matrix.rationale: Adds an explicitly rebuildable lifecycle envelope without changing historical event bytes.
Adds a bounded advisory pointer with an explicit non-authority ceiling.
Older consumers cannot represent the advisory pointer and require explicit approval before loss.
Downgrading drops a versioned advisory field and therefore cannot be implicit.
Direct downgrade would collapse lifecycle and advisory semantics into an unbounded legacy shape.

historical_event_rule: EVENT_ORIGINAL_BYTES_ARE_IMMUTABLE; migration uses adapters during replay
